preconditions.description: The length of the input string s must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string s must consist only of lowercase characters.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the omeric string followed by the frequencies of each prefix as space-separated integers.
The number of prefix counts must match the length of the omeric string.
